Concerns over artificial intelligence adoption have impacted investor sentiment, although a stronger dollar provided additional support.

title: Sebi proposes Rs 50,000 fine for firms not cooperating with monitoring agencies
description: Sebi has proposed a fine of ₹50,000 for each instance of non-cooperation by listed companies. Monitoring agencies would be empowered to submit reports directly to stock exchanges. Stricter enforcement measures may include freezing promoters' demat accounts. Companies are required to provide information to monitoring agencies within prescribed timelines. This initiative aims to ensure better accountability regarding the utilization of funds raised through public issues.

A decline in the India VIX suggests lower market anxiety, while foreign institutional investors recorded net sales, countered by robust domestic institutional purchases.

title: Can RBI’s six forex measures help stabilise the rupee?

These steps have successfully lifted the rupee's value against the dollar by approximately 150 paise. A new cash reserve requirement affects large foreign exchange derivatives, increasing hedging costs for companies. The central bank has also restricted speculative trading in rupee currency derivatives to help control the market.

title: Sebi extends IPO size flexibility by six months to March 2027

Lead managers are now permitted to modify offer documents to accommodate these size revisions, ensuring that the main objectives continue to be met.
